description: Coal power plants in Indonesia: ownership, investments, and impacts is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Angela TRITTO. This dataset includes information on coal power plants in Indonesia. It was created by merging different dataset such as the Global Energy Monitor (GEM, formerly Coalswarm), an open-access source on coal power plants; an open-access database on emissions of coal power plants in Indonesia published by the American Chemical Society containing data from the proprietary ... Coverage: national (ID); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
